test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 10th December 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following is a book by RK Narayan?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Swami and Friends**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Rasipuram Krishnaswami Iyer Narayanaswami**, commonly known as R. K. Narayan.
 
• He was an **Indian writer** known for his famous books 
 
 
• Swami and Friends.
 
• The Guide.
 
• The Vendor of Sweets.
 
• The Ramayana.
 
• The Mahabharata.
 
• Malgudi days
 
 
 
• He was also **nominated** for the** Nobel Prize for Literature** multiple times.
 
• He was honoured by **Padma Bhushan(1964) and Padma Vibhushan (2001)**.
 
• He served as a **member of Parliament Rajya Sabha** from 1986 to 1992.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__ **

 
• **Angry River, Roads to Mussoorie and The Blue Umbrella** were written by **R****uskin bond**.
 
• Ruskin Bond is an Indian writer of **British descent**.
 
• He won **Sahitya Academy Award** in 1992 for **Our Trees Still Grow in Dehra**, his novel in English.
 
• He was honoured with the** Padma Shri** in 1999 and the **Padma Bhushan** in 2014.
